query: What satisfaction and complaint themes appear in Yelp reviews?

per_column.name: service_quality
per_column.rationale: Service quality is a core aspect of restaurant satisfaction/complaints and is a genuine part-of the experience being evaluated.

per_column.name: staff_attitude
per_column.rationale: Staff attitude (friendly/rude/indifferent) is a distinct constitutive aspect of the dining experience driving satisfaction or complaints.

per_column.name: food_taste_rating
per_column.rationale: Food taste/quality is a central aspect of a restaurant review and a legitimate part of the satisfaction concept.

per_column.name: standout_item_mention
per_column.rationale: A boolean flag for whether a standout item is mentioned is a detection/indicator rather than an aspect of satisfaction; it largely overlaps with food_taste_rating and does not carve out a distinct facet of the concept.

per_column.name: value_perception
per_column.rationale: Perceived value/price is a distinct aspect of satisfaction and a common complaint theme, a genuine part-of the concept.

per_column.name: ambiance_atmosphere
per_column.rationale: Ambiance/atmosphere is a recognized independent facet of the dining experience contributing to satisfaction or complaints.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine constitutive facets of restaurant satisfaction/complaints (service, staff, food, value, ambiance), realizing a part-of decomposition well. Mutual exclusivity is lowered because service_quality and staff_attitude overlap conceptually (service delivery includes staff behavior), and standout_item_mention overlaps with food_taste_rating while functioning as a detection flag rather than a distinct aspect. Exhaustiveness is good: the set covers food, service, staff, value, and atmosphere, though it omits some common facets such as cleanliness/hygiene, wait time/speed, and portion size/quantity.
